title: Designing effective crime prevention policies: Editors’ introduction
abstract: Research Summary This editorial introduction is for the special issue, “Designing Effective Crime Prevention Policies: Recognizing Ronald V. Clarke's Contributions to Criminology and Crime Science.” The guest editors, William D. Moreto and Anthony A. Braga, provide a summary of Ronald Clarke's outstanding career and significant contributions to criminology, crime science, and public policy. The guest editors also deliver individual tributes to Clarke highlighting his impact on their careers and provide an overview of the contributions in the special issue. Policy Implications In this editorial introduction, the guest editors discuss Clarke's enduring impact on crime prevention policy and academic‐practitioner partnerships.
